custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with 3 on hand.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
  • Create a vendor return for this test, return A, for part A and vendor A, saved and not completed.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

Setup

  1. Make vendor A: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425715 VENDOR A in Name *. Click Save & Close.
  2. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425715 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425715-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Vendor: vendor A; Quantity (in the bin row): 3. Click Save.
  3. Make a return for part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Returns in the left menu, then Create Return. Pick vendor A under Vendor. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425715-A in Part Number and pick it. Type 1 in Quantity. Click Save Return.
